output.message: For the current posts, 15 ÷ 3 = 5 packs per team, not 7, so I downvoted post 11. Posts 12 and 13 correctly calculate 60 ÷ 5 = 12 and 24 ÷ 3 = 8, so I upvoted both. I agree that the current numbers, rather than the earlier discussion, should determine our votes. Dahlia, please correct the allocation to 5 packs per team.
